costEvidence.reviewRationale: The third 20-sample soak used 8.65904% of the governed US$5 ceiling and all 20 planned samples executed. The controlled educational fail-closed outcomes do not justify increasing the ceiling.

assessmentItemClassification.finding: Two Assessment Item samples failed strict governed-requirement coverage after the single permitted repair. Revision already compiles subquestion requirementIds from coverageEvidence requirementId mappings, so the prior duplicated cross-reference engineering class did not recur. The remaining failure is that the provider-authored educational coverage evidence did not genuinely evidence exactly the governed requirement set; deterministic validation rejected the affected item as designed.

markingPackClassification.finding: Two calculation Marking Pack samples remained without sufficient final-answer accuracy or consequential-error treatment in provider-authored rubric descriptors after the single permitted repair. Rubric descriptor meaning is generative educational marking judgement under Q1; deterministic validation rejected insufficient marking guidance as designed. One initial unasked-demand defect was corrected by the bounded repair before the remaining educational rubric defect failed closed.

classification.previousQ7DefectFinding: Neither the first-soak omission-before-repair class nor the second-soak duplicated coverageEvidence/requirementIds cross-reference class recurred. The v5 Assessment Item boundary derived requirementIds from coverageEvidence and reached strict semantic coverage validation.
classification.engineeringBoundaryFinding: No escaped engineering-boundary exception was recorded. Complete diagnostics, the single permitted targeted repair and whole-artifact revalidation all operated at the intended production boundaries.
classification.workflowConclusionNote: The GitHub Actions soak job concluded failure because the qualification harness deliberately fails whenever controlled fail-closed samples require engineering-vs-educational classification. This durable classification resolves that manual gate; the workflow exit code is not itself evidence of an engineering reliability defect.

qualificationOutcome.nextStep: Persist Q7 PASS on a governed evidence PR. V2-F/Q8 remains a separate Founder-approved eligibility transition before status may become qualified or livePilotEligible may become true.
